verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single docs line saying you can change how you get paid for each merchant account. That loosely suggests configurable payouts, but nothing shows payout schedules or arrival visibility, and nothing shows faster options such as next-day or instant payouts. missing for 10: visibility into when each payout lands, documented next-day or instant payout options, on-demand payout acceleration, any independent or hands-on corroboration.
